comment: Geometry every grid game writes the same way. Named in "include" like any other file, never loaded on its own: a name whose definition is nowhere in the file, and nowhere in anything the file mentions, breaks the one property a game file has. Cards, zones and phases do not belong here — those are the game, and a base file that starts carrying them is a junk drawer whose first inheritance nobody can find the source of. A tag earns a place here once two shipped games have written the same one.
